item.title: Dennou Sentai: Lavian Three
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Wendy Magazine
  • 発売日: 1994-07-15
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 電脳戦隊ラヴィアンスリー
  • 英語名: Dennou Sentai: Lavian Three

あらすじ

In 1999, a global computer network was assembled, allowing unprecedented transportation speed to different locations on the Earth through virtual reality. But it also opened virtual portals to another dimensions. The ruler of one of them, the magical empire Lemuria, concocted a plan to use the computer’s energy in order to destroy the Earth. Luckily, not everyone in Lemuria shared his views, including a beautiful girl named Lares, who contacted a group of computer-loving high-school girls in Japan, and turned them into super-heroines who fight in cyberspace!

item.title: Nurse Yuu no Muma Sensen
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Wendy Magazine
  • 発売日: 1993-09-04
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ナースゆうの夢魔戦線
  • 英語名: Nurse Yuu no Muma Sensen

あらすじ

“Nurse Yuu no Mumasensen” is an adventure game with a rather cryptic story. The player controls a young nurse named Yuu, who finds herself near a secluded military hospital, unable to understand whether she is dreaming or not. She then begins to work at the hospital, becoming more and more intrigued by the events happening in it.

item.title: Dareka... Special
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Wendy Magazine
  • 発売日: 1993-07
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 誰か… スペシャル
  • 英語名: Dareka… Special

あらすじ

Some mysterious things have been happening down at the space station. Odd energy readings, a naked girl materializes out of thin air, voices everywhere…

Can you find out what’s going on? Investigate, speak with people, piece together what this is. People are holding secrets. Lives are at stake.

Oh, and lesbian sex. There’s some of that in there too. This is a game by Wendy Magazine, so you can expect some of that in there too.
